description: A blue benzo tab that files the sharp edges off a bad night.

overdose.message: You lie down to rest your eyes for just a second, and never open them.

phases.end_message: The calm wears thin and the worries file back in.
phases.peak_message: The panic unclenches. Whatever it was, it can wait.

effects.take_line: You slip a {name} tab under your tongue.

withdrawal.message: You're on edge again, and you know exactly what would fix it.

stages.easing: You doze for twenty minutes and wake up more tired than before.
stages.onset: Everything the lull was muffling comes back at once.
stages.peak: Your hands won't stay still and your jaw aches from clenching it in your sleep.
stages.rising: Every sound is too loud. A door shutting two rooms away makes you jump.
stages.tail: You can be around people again, but you still check where the exits are.

name: lull
